versions.subject: multiple dll sideloading rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\7za.dll'
filter_main_legit_path:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\7za.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\*") ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\*"))
